title: Episode 9: The Defenestration of Prague: The Seventy-Foot Fall That Ignited a Continent
description: On May 23, 1618, enraged Protestant Bohemian nobles stormed Prague Castle and hurled two royal imperial governors and their secretary out of a high chancery window. Falling seventy feet, all three survived by landing in a massive pile of stable waste—triggering the Thirty Years' War.
